summary_en: ¥10.0B upper limit, 4.0M shares (2.4% of shares outstanding), acquisition period Aug 6–Oct 30, 2026, method: open-market purchase via Tokyo Stock Exchange. All acquired shares to be cancelled on Nov 12, 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters relating to treasury share acquisition and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Mercari's board of directors resolved on Aug 5, 2026 to acquire up to 4.0 million of its ordinary shares, representing 2.4% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥10.0 billion. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase through the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from Aug 6 to Oct 30, 2026. The company stated that the buyback is in accordance with its capital-allocation framework disclosed in the June 2025 full-year results announcement. All shares acquired under this program will be cancelled on Nov 12, 2026.
